modes.title: I completed my homework and want to compare my solutions

solution_button.prompt_enable_show_solutions: From this point forward, you provide the R code for the solution to a specific task if the user requests the solution to a specific task. Avoid giving solutions otherwise.
solution_button.prompt_disable_show_solutions: From this point forward, you must not provide the R code for the solution to a specific task if the user requests the solution to a specific task. Always focus on offering guidance or clarifications instead of direct solutions.
